name: Wizmech
source:
The discovery of new technologies has caused malignant beings to sprout through the land.  It is up to Professor Lamb to follow through with his new discoveries and bring a solution to this heinous invasion. Or will he?

[from [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/wizmech]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新技术的发现导致邪恶生物在这片土地上萌芽。兰姆教授有责任贯彻他的新发现，为这一令人发指的入侵找到解决方案。或者他会吗？

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/wizmech]itch.io[/url]]
